Shown: its 500 most cited papers, 100 of them with Latin American authors (the most cited of those come first, up to 20%); placed by year, every line is one paper citing another inside this set.
meta.foot: Source: data/ and out/clusters/ of restrepo/inspireauth10 (INSPIRE-HEP tables of 2026-11-09), made by reproduce/topics/timelines.py. 500 papers, 2943 citation links; 100 with Latin American authors (of 364 in the topic). Labels: the 15 most cited and the 20 most cited with Latin American authors. Citations are INSPIRE's totals.
